g1.label: 1. A partnership of ___ countries
g1.why: The text says the EU is a partnership of 27 countries.

g2.label: 2. The EU began after ___
g2.why: The text says the EU began after World War 2.

g3.label: 3. Goods move without extra ___
g3.why: The text says goods can move across EU borders without extra taxes.

g4.label: 4. Citizens can ___
g4.why: The text says citizens of EU countries can live and work freely in other member states.

g5.label: 5. The UK joined in ___
g5.why: The text says the UK joined the European Community in 1973.

g6.label: 6. In 2016, a ___
g6.why: The text says a referendum was held in 2016.

g7.label: 7. Leaving the EU became known as ___
g7.why: The text says the process of the UK leaving the EU became known as Brexit.

g8.label: 8. Since leaving, the UK ___
g8.why: The text says the UK still trades with the EU since leaving.

g1.label: 1. Since 1957, countries ___ the EU
g1.why: ‘Since 1957’ signals an action continuing to now, so the present perfect ‘have joined’ is used.

g2.label: 2. The UK ___ in 1973
g2.why: ‘In 1973’ is a finished, specific past time, so the simple past ‘joined’ is used.

g3.label: 3. Many students ___ abroad
g3.why: The ongoing relevance of exchange programmes calls for the present perfect ‘have studied’.

g4.label: 4. In 2016, the British people ___
g4.why: ‘In 2016’ is a finished, specific past time, so the simple past ‘voted’ is used.

g5.label: 5. Over the years, the EU ___
g5.why: ‘Over the years’ signals an action continuing to now, so the present perfect ‘has grown’ is used.

g6.label: 6. The UK ___ the EU in 2020
g6.why: ‘In 2020’ is a finished, specific past time, so the simple past ‘left’ is used.

g7.label: 7. Since Brexit, the trade rules ___
g7.why: ‘Since Brexit’ signals an action continuing to now, so the present perfect ‘have changed’ is used.

g8.label: 8. "I ___ to Brussels"
g8.why: ‘Never’ with the present perfect describes an experience up to now.

g1.label: 1. Created ___ countries wanted to avoid war
g1.why: ‘Because’ introduces the reason countries created the EU.

g2.label: 2. Goods move freely; ___
g2.why: ‘In addition’ adds a further point after the semicolon.

g3.label: 3. Students study abroad, ___
g3.why: ‘For example’ introduces a specific instance — the Erasmus programme.

g4.label: 4. ___ the UK joined in 1973...
g4.why: ‘Although’ introduces a contrast at the start of the sentence.

g5.label: 5. A majority voted to leave; ___
g5.why: ‘Therefore’ shows the result of the vote — the UK leaving.

g6.label: 6. No longer a member; ___ it trades
g6.why: ‘However’ shows a contrast — no longer a member, but still trading.

g7.label: 7. Changed a lot ___ it was founded
g7.why: ‘Since’ introduces the starting point (the 1950s), matching the present perfect ‘has changed’.

g8.label: 8. Cooperate ___ they can solve problems
g8.why: ‘So that’ introduces the purpose of cooperating.
